input_boundary.future_only: A later same-origin transport may call the renderer with one already server-validated state snapshot and the locale-owned assistant-copy messages. This task creates neither transport nor polling.
input_boundary.stale_event_rule: A state snapshot whose epoch is not greater than the last accepted epoch for this assistant surface is ignored.

rendering.message_source: The renderer selects only reviewed locale-owned states/resource_states/actions.retry text from assistant-copy.json; it does not accept visible text from the snapshot.
rendering.recovery: Every accepted resource state exposes a keyboard-reachable same-page link to the deterministic documentation search. Retry wording is informational until a later guarded transport provides a real action.
rendering.controls: The question, send, stop and clear controls remain disabled. The renderer never changes disabled or aria-disabled attributes.
rendering.duplicate: A busy or duplicate state does not start another worker or request; the rendering layer only reports the state supplied by a later bounded controller.

boundaries.page_load: The script only registers a future-callable function. It performs no fetch, model inspection, status poll, retrieval, worker start, timeout, retry, unload, request or DOM update on page load.
